title: The Classics in Context; Greek and Roman Culture in Context
description:
This introductory course will examine the ancient Greeks and Romans in Italy through investigation of significant sites, monuments and museum collections in Rome and the Bay of Naples area. The essence of the course is virtual site visits that bring students into contact with original artifacts and monuments through which we may understand these ancient cultures.

This is a Global Classrooms course, developed in partnership with the Office of International Affairs (OIA) to provide opportunities for virtual, project-based, international collaboration.
